related.title: RAJA：執行政策與歸約所有權
related.titleEn: RAJA: execution policies and reduction ownership
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩布局索引、地址跨度與跨後端資料測試；48/56正確，所有12邏輯元素保持相同且地址不越界；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver layout indices, address strides, and cross-backend data tests. Verify offsets 48 and 56 with all 12 logical elements unchanged and in bounds. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 畫四組[1,2]、[3,4]、[5,6]、[7,8]的私有部分和3、7、11、15，再單次加入初值；46/36與四部分和吻合，輸入被消費一次且初值唯一。
related.differenceEn: Draw partial sums 3, 7, 11, and 15 from four pairs, then add the initializer once. Verify 46 and 36, with each input consumed once and only one initializer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: row-major偏移i×C+j，column-major偏移j×R+i；同一邏輯矩陣可有不同實體跨度；合成R3、C4，元素(i1,j2)，每元素8bytes；求兩布局byte offset；名義式 (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset；變更式 (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
sum結果為初值s0加每個輸入一次；若每工作者重複加入非零初值，結果會偏移；合成輸入1..8，初值s0=10；改s0=0，工作分四組；名義式 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum；變更式 8*9/2 = 36 sum。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Row-major offset is iC+j; column-major offset is jR+i. The same logical matrix can have different physical strides. Synthetic R = 3, C = 4, index (1, 2), and 8 bytes per element. Calculate both byte offsets. Nominal (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset; changed (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.

The result is one initial value plus each input exactly once. Repeating a nonzero initializer per worker changes the answer. Synthetic inputs 1 through 8 with initial value 10 versus 0, partitioned into four groups. Nominal 10+8*9/2 = 46 sum; changed 8*9/2 = 36 sum. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: UCX multi-rail transport: bottlenecks and traffic splits
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩布局索引、地址跨度與跨後端資料測試；48/56正確，所有12邏輯元素保持相同且地址不越界；請另一位學徒依交付件重新推導一組；未通過或資料不足必須明記，不以品牌或峰值取代證據。

Verify offsets 48 and 56 with all 12 logical elements unchanged and in bounds. Have another learner derive one case from the handover; label failures or missing evidence without substituting brand names or peak rates.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「UCX 多軌傳輸：瓶頸與分流比例」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付鏈路拓樸、兩種分流時間與共享資源假說表。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct UCX multi-rail transport: bottlenecks and traffic splits with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver link topology, split timings and shared-resource hypotheses.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: row-major偏移i×C+j，column-major偏移j×R+i；同一邏輯矩陣可有不同實體跨度；合成R3、C4，元素(i1,j2)，每元素8bytes；求兩布局byte offset；名義式 (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset；變更式 (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
把 1200 MB 分給每軌，計算各自 60 與 120 ms，標出慢軌尾端。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Row-major offset is iC+j; column-major offset is jR+i. The same logical matrix can have different physical strides. Synthetic R = 3, C = 4, index (1, 2), and 8 bytes per element. Calculate both byte offsets. Nominal (1*4+2)*8 = 48 byte offset; changed (2*3+1)*8 = 56 byte offset. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Assign 1200 MB to each rail and calculate 60 and 120 ms, marking the slow-rail tail.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
